I used the wrong revision id — I made one up. The actual current revision id is 82f1fcb2-55a7-4074-92d0-74c4b9528ad0. The tool returned that revision (unchanged content presumably, since my "expected revision" mismatched?). Actually the output returned revision_id 82f1fcb2... with the same sha as the original. So my edit was rejected silently? It returned the current revision (unchanged source sha). So the edit failed due to wrong expected_revision_id.

Now supply the correct expected revision id.
